tænkt.da: Nogle vil måske mene, at dette er et meget tænkt eksempel, men det var ikke desto mindre det, der skete.
tænkt.en: Some may find this a very contrived example, but it is nonetheless what happened.

glosses: stuff, nonsense (colloquial: hvad er det for noget tøj?)

tøj.value: Uncountable — "clothes" as a mass: meget tøj, noget tøj. One garment = et stykke tøj. In compounds -tøj means gear or equipment: værktøj (tools), legetøj (toys), køretøj (vehicle).

glosses: training, qualification (hvad er din uddannelse? = what did you train or study as?)
out of the question, impossible (det er udelukket = that's out of the question)
perfectly well, very well (du ved udmærket = you know perfectly well)
to make use of, make the most of (udnytte tiden = use the time well)
to expose to, subject to (være udsat for = be exposed to)
to find fault with (have noget at udsætte på)
expression, phrase, term (et dansk udtryk = a Danish expression)
expression, sign (of a feeling or idea)
disagreeing, not in agreement (vi er uenige = we disagree)
young (of an animal): cub, chick, kitten
shift (a period of work, e.g. nattevagt = night shift)
used to (vant til: jeg er vant til det = I'm used to it)
aware (only in blive var = notice, become aware of)
(only in tage vare på) to take care of, look after

varm.value: Jeg er varm and jeg har det varmt both just mean 'I'm warm/hot'. Være varm på nogen = to fancy someone.

glosses: ingen vegne: nowhere (komme ingen vegne = get nowhere)

vegne.value: Only used in fixed phrases: 'på vegne af' / 'på mine vegne' (on behalf of), 'alle vegne' (everywhere), 'ingen vegne' (nowhere).

glosses: surely; ..., right? (asks the listener to agree: du kommer vel? = you're coming, right?)
well (formal, in set phrases: vel mødt = welcome)
I hope you enjoyed it (said by the host after a meal)
(ironic) be my guest, good luck with that

senses: welcome (plural velkomne): I er velkomne = you are (all) welcome

glosses: to widen (only in vide ud = widen, let out)
to know (facts: jeg ved det ikke = I don't know)
on, onward (gå videre = go on, move on)
on to someone else (sende videre = pass on, forward)
far (så vidt jeg ved = as far as I know)
lost (fare vild, gå vild = get lost)
vild med = crazy about, very keen on

vild.value: vildt is very common as an intensifier in speech: vildt godt = really good, vildt sjovt = so much fun.

senses: reel, winch

glosses: to work, function (min telefon virker ikke = my phone doesn't work)
to seem, appear (hun virker glad = she seems happy)
to take effect, work (medicinen virker = the medicine is working)
to work, be active (virke som læge = work as a doctor)

senses: certain, some (visse mennesker = certain people)

glosses: carriage, car (of a train: vogn 3 = car 3)

senses: an adult, grown-up (de voksne = the grown-ups)

glosses: our, ours (formal, with et-words; everyday Danish uses vores)
danger, peril (only in: stå i våde = be in danger)

væddemål.da: Vi indgik et væddemål om, hvem der ville vinde.
væddemål.en: We made a bet on who would win.

være.contains: Det er Anders der har spist kagen
være.da: Det er Anders, der har spist kagen.
være.en: It's Anders who has eaten the cake.

glosses: room (in a home or hotel: soveværelse = bedroom)
please, go ahead, help yourself (e.g. when food is served)
være værsgo at ... = have no choice but to ...
ingen årsag = you're welcome, don't mention it
to eat greedily, stuff oneself (of people; rude)

æde.value: Used about animals. Said about people it sounds coarse; the normal verb is spise.

glosses: one (the number, stressed; the accent sets it apart from the article en = a/an)
one (emphatic: just one person or thing)
moment (et øjeblik! = just a moment!; i øjeblikket = at the moment)

øve.value: Usually reflexive: øve sig (på noget) = practise (something).
